headline: UBS Warns Brazil Risks Recession in 2027 With Limited Space for Selic Rate Cuts
summary: UBS GWM warned that Brazil could face a recession in 2027 without finding room for expressive cuts to the Selic interest rate due to weak economic activity and accelerating inflation.
why: Persistent inflation combined with economic stagnation creates a complex dilemma for central bank monetary easing cycles.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Anticipated recession risks and restricted monetary easing weigh on domestic economic sentiment.
